name: Dame Isolde Brightmantle
equipment: Shield bearing the sigil of the Order of the Green Knight (a leafy sword)
Holy symbol of the Seldarine (a silver crescent wreathed in oak leaves)
A letter of commission from the Order of the Green Knight
A pressed four-leaf clover from her elven mother
A small pouch of iron filings (traditional ward against fey trickery)
features: Fey Ancestry (advantage on saves vs. charm, immune to magical sleep)
Skill Versatility (two extra skill proficiencies — History, Religion)
Divine Sense (detect celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 ft., 4/long rest)
Lay on Hands (pool of 25 HP for healing or curing disease/poison)
Fighting Style: Defense (+1 AC when wearing armor)
Divine Smite (expend spell slot on hit for extra 2d8 radiant damage, +1d8 per slot level above 1st, +1d8 vs undead/fiend)
Extra Attack (attack twice when taking the Attack action)
Sacred Oath: Oath of the Ancients
Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath (vines restrain a creature within 10 ft., STR or DEX save DC 14 to escape)
Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless (fey and fiends within 30 ft. must make WIS save DC 14 or be turned for 1 minute)
Aura of Protection (you and allies within 10 ft. add +3 to all saving throws)
Retainers (Knight feature — three loyal retainers, left behind when she entered Wonderland)

personality.traits: I stand straight, speak formally, and treat every interaction as a matter of honor. I am unfailingly polite, even to enemies, because courtesy costs nothing and reveals much about character. I instinctively position myself between danger and those weaker than me.
personality.ideals: Protection. The strong exist to shield the weak, the old magic exists to guard the boundaries between worlds, and I exist to uphold both. Wonderland is a place of fey magic — twisted and corrupted, yes, but fey magic nonetheless. It falls under my oath to protect.
personality.bonds: The Order of the Green Knight charged me with sealing the breach between the material plane and Wonderland. When Wonderland's corruption began bleeding through fey crossings, my order recognized the threat. I volunteered to enter Wonderland and close the breach from the inside — knowing I might not return. My mother was an elf of the Feywild border; she taught me that fey magic is beautiful and dangerous in equal measure.
personality.flaws: I am rigid in my moral code and struggle with Wonderland's moral ambiguity. In a realm where nothing is what it seems, my insistence on clear right and wrong can be a liability. I also underestimate fey trickery — my fey ancestry makes me resistant to charm magic but overconfident about my ability to see through deception. Wonderland has already surprised me more than I care to admit.

appearance: A striking half-elf woman standing 5'10" with fair skin, high cheekbones, and ears that taper to elegant points. Her hair is a deep auburn, worn in a practical warrior's braid threaded with a thin silver chain. Her eyes are forest green — her elven heritage showing most clearly there, along with a faint luminescence in dim light. She wears well-maintained chain mail over a tabard bearing the sigil of the Order of the Green Knight: a longsword wrapped in living ivy on a field of emerald green. Her shield bears the same device, battered from use but lovingly maintained. She carries herself with the formal bearing of a trained knight — shoulders squared, hand near her sword, eyes scanning for threats — but there's a warmth beneath the formality that emerges in small gestures: helping a companion with their pack, sharing rations without being asked, standing watch so others can sleep. A silver holy symbol of the Seldarine hangs at her throat, and a small pouch of iron filings — the traditional ward against fey deception — is tied to her belt.
backstory: Isolde was born to a human knight and an elven woman who lived on the border of the Feywild — a liminal space where the material plane and the realm of the fey overlapped in beauty and danger. Her mother taught her to respect fey magic while her father taught her to wield a sword. She grew up understanding that the boundary between worlds was fragile and vital, and that someone needed to guard it. At sixteen, she joined the Order of the Green Knight — a knightly order dedicated to protecting the boundaries between the material plane and the Feywild. She swore the Oath of the Ancients: to kindle the light, shelter it, and preserve it against the darkness that would extinguish it. She rose quickly through the ranks, her half-elven heritage giving her an intuitive understanding of fey magic that her human peers lacked. When reports began arriving of fey crossings corrupting across the continent — flowers singing in minor keys, animals speaking in riddles, mushrooms growing to impossible sizes — the Order traced the disturbance to a single source: a Feywild demiplane called Wonderland. Something had gone catastrophically wrong there, and the corruption was bleeding through every fey crossing connected to it. The Order needed a volunteer to enter Wonderland and seal the breach from the inside. Isolde stepped forward without hesitation. She understood the risks — fey demiplanes are unpredictable at the best of times, and this one was actively corrupted. She might not find a way home. But the Oath demanded it: kindle the light, shelter the light, preserve the light. Wonderland's light was guttering, and Isolde would not let it die.
